adaptations: Use public build metadata in Settings.Global hecker_pif_config, written by native privileged Settings, instead of the Axion-wide spoof-manager/AIDL stack.

PIF initialization in ActivityThread is limited to com.google.android.gms.unstable and com.android.vending. Native property virtualization and optional signature/provider hooks run only in the attestation process. Game profiles are initialized separately for configured app packages.
GameProps and TrickyStore/keybox hooks are ported separately from the same Axion revision. Photos retains PixelOS PropImitationHooks. No private attestation keys are shipped.
Malformed/empty/incomplete profiles leave the adapter inactive. Profiles are activated on target process restart.
Native virtualization is the upstream October 19 patch applied without fuzz to the pinned Android 17 SystemProperties JNI source.

Native Settings manages game/target/keybox/patch imports through UID-scoped AMS Binder methods and atomic 0600 system files; no private key in SettingsProvider. Existing PixelOS PIF/keybox paths defer to selected Axion profiles to prevent double processing.

Ported GamePropsSpoofService and the five TrickyStore classes from the same immutable Axion source. App reads are restricted to packages assigned to their real calling UID; only primary system/root may manage imports. System/secondary/isolated UIDs do not enter app certificate hooks.

Fixed EC signing against Android 17 repackaged Bouncy Castle using the shared lightweight RSA/EC signers; signature algorithm follows the imported signing key. Imported certificate metadata is copied back into the Android 17 key response.

Android 17 ML-DSA/Curve25519, user-authentication-bound, device-ID and explicit attestation-key generation retain the native path. Selected software generation requires an imported matching keybox and a challenge. Key usage follows requested purposes; application signing identity comes from PackageManager.

Block XML entities/oversized configuration, verify imported key/certificate pairing, reject malformed games, validate patch dates, and persist configuration through atomic private system files. No new credential/keybox download endpoint or private attestation key is bundled.
When a selected TrickyStore keybox is present, ActivityThread skips the optional PIF blocking provider so it cannot intercept the certificate path. Photos stays in existing PixelOS hooks.
verification: Android 17 framework/keystore javac type-check against a locked implementation JAR with generated/private API surfaces supplied; host scoped-storage/parser/game/RSA/EC certificate tests, native sanitizers and Settings SDK/resource compilation. Full Soong build, coral hardware tests and actual attestation verdict still required.
